notes.title: Patch 2: New artifacts, updated demo and autumn Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]
It's been a fun experience getting to make this game for you, and as I reach my first sale, I wanted to update Mossroot and give a little more for you all as a thank you for buying and playing this game. It's far exceeded my expectations and I'm happy to see people enjoy it!

[h1]New Artifacts![/h1]
I've added in 5 new artifacts for you to play with! I took from concepts for scrapped characters and turned them into items for you to change up your gameplay and strategy for each run. Now you can focus on new angles, like choosing horde battles or saving up money to try and conquer each territory as you make your way up the mountain!

[h1]Fixed Demo[/h1]
For a while now, I've been using the steam next fest demo as the demo for the game. Fortunately the game hadn't changed much between then and now, but what has changed is how many bugs and glitches existed in the original version. So I took the time to bring the demo up to date with the current version and hopefully all the old bugs have been squished. As always, if you're facing some bugs, feel free to share them in the community area and I'll make sure to note them down!

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Updated Demo to current version of game. Fixed a variety of old bugs that existed only in the demo.
[*]     5 new artifacts added
[olist]
[*] Advance Plans - +2 attack per enemy.
Heavy Wallet - +1 attack for every 50 gold.
Last Stand Trinket - +4 Special when at less than half health.
Priscilla's Blessing - Prevent the first hit done to any teammate.
Rune cluster - +1 to Move, Passive, Attack, Special and all Range.
[/olist]
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Fixed some instances of the incorrect character shown as talking in a dialog
[/list]
[h2]Glitches[/h2]
[list]
[*]     Can no longer recruit Quinn multiple times (sorry)
[*]     Beating the true ending of the game will now properly save Quinn's recruitment requests
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
It's been a week and the release has been amazing! The outpouring of positive reception has far exceeded my expectations. It's been such a rewarding release, and it's not been without plenty of requests for quality of life changes, and that's what this is for!

Easily the biggest change here is I've double the inventory at shops, so feel free to shop to your heart's content and even buy two artifacts if you can afford it. I've also lowered the movement on many characters, to encourage more thoughtful exploration, and enemies will now properly attack before moving, to prevent the ai from sometimes moving and doing nothing.

 The rest is all bug fixes, or many many quality of life features. Hotkeys always existed in the game, but should now hopefully be clearer, so it's easier to move quicker. Resolution changing is now supported, in a limited fashion, certain aspects of this game do not like moving past 16:9 ratio.

Moving into the future, I'm excited to take a small break, but I'm constantly monitoring the community to make sure no deadly bugs persist, hopefully I have squashed the majority of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081056/718405aea3073597419d57a0fa690a9589347589.png[/img]

Gameplay
[list]
[*]     Doubled the amount of items available at the shop
[*]     Adjusted Map Generation of the forest and cave maps
[*]     Balance
[*]     Madeline Move -1
[*]     Saria Specials uses -1
[*]     Sersha Move -1
[*]     Oran Move -1
[*]     Barry Move -2
[*]     Conor move -2
[*]     Rudolph Move -1
[*]     Maeve Move -2
[*]     Spider Move +1
[/list]
    AI
[list]
[*]     Enemies will now consider attacking before moving
[/list]
    UI
[list]
[*]     Clarified replace teammates button to "Replace Fallen Teammates"
[*]     Fixed info toolbox to not hover directly over the object being looked at.
[*]     Hotkeys for Attack, Move, and Special are now displayed on the buttons themselves.
[*]     Added hotkeys to cycle between units using the 1-4 keys
[*]     Option to change Screen resolution now available in options
[*]     Changing resolution in windowed mode is now available! (Let me know if this leads to any ugly setups, 
I spent forever trying to prevent that.)
[/list]
    Glitches
[list]
[*]     Fixed instances where certain sound effects weren't affected by volume sliders
[*]     Game now remembers your preference for fullscreen or windowed.
[*]     Some Spawns led to Statues becoming inaccessible
[*]     Wooden Sword now gives the proper ability instead of the Holy Shield ability
[/list]

notes.title: Mossroot is Here!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081056/cf8811ad16042396acfdc6683dca6601631fb811.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Mossroot is finally here!![/h1]
I'm so happy to finally let you all see the finished product at play, I will be anxiously watching for any and all reports to fix for bugs as I see them, It's been a real pleasure making this game and I'm so excited for you all to see it! 

There is a 15% discount for the first week! Add it to your wishlists as well so you can be informed of any future deals.

notes.title: MossRoot Releasing August 2nd!!
notes.content:
[h1]August 2nd[/h1]
It's been a long road, but I'm happy to finally officially announce the release date of MossRoot as August 2nd! I'm so excited to be able to finally share the finished project with you all, and have been spending this last month hard at work finishing the final touches of art and writing for this game. It's been an adventure getting to this point, and hope that you all will be pleased with the final product!

[h1]What's left on my end?[/h1]
The game itself is complete. Gameplay, aside from some balancing tweaks is locked in, and barring any major bugs will not need any major changes until the official release! I have a few more pieces of art to pound out and some dialog to refine and finalize and will otherwise be playtesting as much as possible to make sure it's as bug free as it can be. 

[h1]A Thank You[/h1]
I'm a single dev, and aside from the music provided by the wonderful Sam Shandley, I've been in charge of every aspect of this games development. This has been a wonderful passion project, and it's been a fun balancing act as we get closer to release. I'm pounding out all the glitches I and playtesters can find, and if any pop up during release I will do whatever I can to fix them as they release. The amount of support and outreach I've received has been heartwarming, and I appreciate every single wishlist I've gotten. Thank you all so much, and I look forward to seeing you release day!
